title: Feature Selection
objectives: Explain the key ideas behind Feature Selection.
Describe why Feature Selection matters in Data Science.

definition: Feature Selection is a core concept in Data Science. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Feature Selection is
theory.body: Feature Selection describes the methods and patterns used within Data Science to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Feature Selection is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Feature Selection matters
theory.body: Without Feature Selection, systems built with Data Science are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Feature Selection works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Feature Selection follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Feature Selection.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Feature Selection
theory.body: Feature Selection offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
